AC AMENDMENT (gap-analysis #8):
WORKTREE-GUIDE.md must additionally document:
- WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK override env var (and the mandatory REASON companion env var).
- --force bypass semantics: what it overrides (PR, uncommitted, unmerged), what it does NOT (protected branch); URL printing still occurs.
- 3-tier enumeration (main session PR via --head, sub-PRs via --base, fallback to SHA-based + search) so operators understand WHY a refusal happened when no main PR appears to exist.

- [ ] Doc mentions WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK override
  Verify: grep -q 'WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK' plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md
- [ ] Doc covers --force bypass semantics
  Verify: grep -qE 'force.*bypass|protected.*not.*bypass' plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md
